title: Kelsus
text: “C’mon, let’s get moving, shall we? Emia and the others, please rest at the hotel on the island. We’ll come by later.”
“Ah, yes… I am a bit curious about that island, but… it’s probably best to leave it to you heroes.”
Itsuki seemed to be trying to press forward without much fuss, I say.
“Feels like a page out of a story, doesn’t it… ‘Approaching the mysteries of the world’ and all that.”
“Bueeh!”
Riska and Rabbit Guy couldn’t hide their excitement, though they also seemed a bit deflated by Itsuki’s flat attitude, indeed.
“Shion, you’re not getting on the boat?”
“Nah, swimming’s better for training the body.”

Father called out to Crocodile Guy, who was swimming nearby. Crocodile Guy, despite his bulk, swam quite differently from Older Sister, using his tail as well. According to Father, it was actually a rather cool swimming form. Incidentally, Lazy Pig and Panda chose not to follow us, opting instead to rest on the beach of the island with the marketplace. And so we arrived at the island. Since we’d already been there in a previous loop, nothing felt particularly fresh. A familiar castle came into view.
“Ohh, I’d heard about it, but it really is flashy—red energy and everything. What do you call this? Feels like something out of a game.”
“Bit late to be saying that now.”
“We’re still excited though!”

Rabbit Guy and Riska, while not quite on the Queen’s level, clearly had a strong interest in this sort of thing. And so, having passed the hero authentication we’d seen before, the castle gates opened and we went inside.
“Our objective here is the Pioneer Fairy’s special ability, plus various weapons and items.”
“Right. I’ll look for a weapon that’ll give Motoyasu an edge.”
“Ren, wrong objective.”
“I’m Kelsus, woof.”
“Don’t be so particular about it—anyway, could Keel-kun get in too, I wonder?”
“I told you, I’m not that!”
“Ehh… it’d be nice if Keel-kun could come in too.”
“Well, Gaelion and Spear Hero already cleared this one before, nano, but I think it’s fine to explore a bit freely for fun, nano.”
Rival was showing some mysterious consideration, I say.
“By the way, according to Naofumi, nano, this is apparently the ‘castle exploration’ game genre, nano.”
“Ahh… I see, so it’s that kind of dungeon.”
“Well then, let’s begin right away. Mechanically, it seems each hero needs to ride the corresponding weapon vehicle for this to work.”
Just as Wolf was about to substitute for Father’s role and climb aboard, Ren put Keel on instead.
“Kelsus-nii-chan, what are you doing?!”
“…I suppose that reaction was inevitable after all.”
“What were you even planning to do if I hadn’t reacted?!”
“Nothing really… it’s just that Luna’s curious whether Keel is an inult or not.”
“Yeah. Luna wants to know if Keel-kun’s race is the same as Ama’s~”
“I told you, I’m Kelsus, woof!”
Ren was being awfully persistent about it, I say.
“I don’t think Luna-chan’s way of calling you narrows it down enough to identify you, so you don’t need to worry. Kelsus.”
“Please hurry and get on, Ren-san.”
“I’m Kelsus, woof!”

And so, reluctantly, Ren climbed into the designated spot. With a clatter, the door opened. So substitution with Wolf really was possible after all. By the same logic, Rafumi could presumably manage it too, at least for now.
“Seems like the key here just requires someone holding a weapon capable of becoming the corresponding Pioneer Fairy, nano.”
“So it seems. There’s the sacred weapon on the wall along with the surrounding Seven Star Weapons… but there’s one extra. Over there.”
Rabbit Guy noticed and pointed at a section of the mural depicting a bow.
“Was there an eighth one?”
“Ahh… don’t worry about that one, nano. The owner isn’t an enemy, nano.”
“It’s the great Filolial-sama, I say!”
“Is it really a good thing to just casually blurt out mysteries like that…”
And with that, the dungeon entrance opened and we were able to pick up lanterns, I say.
“Now then, who shall go in?”
“Keel.”
“Stop trying to make me go in! Kelsus-nii-chan!”

“If you’re that curious, there’s a fixed dungeon on another island where the boss is a Karma Dog, and it’s specifically an inult-only dungeon, nano. Try charging in there. There’s also a flag that leads deeper into this dungeon, so you’ll end up going eventually anyway, nano.”
“Gaelion-chan, what kind of thing is that to say?!”
Keel protested, I say. Ren, meanwhile, seemed to have taken an interest in that other dungeon.
“Ren-san. Either way, it’d be best to get the special ability available here first.”
“Right. Then let’s begin. And Itsuki… I’m Kelsus, woof!”
So saying, Ren grabbed a lantern, and with a kitchen knife that Father and the others had been using in hand, dashed inside running, I say. Thus began the dungeon exploration, indeed.
“Ah, so the level starts at 1, huh.”
“It goes up as you defeat monsters, nano. Leveling outside the dungeon is also pretty easy here, nano.”
“Seems like a good spot for strengthening in preparation for the Waves. The world really is full of mysteries, that a place like this would be hidden away.”

“Well… if I go by the knowledge from the loops, nano, the mastermind behind the Waves that’s already been defeated crushed or hid anything that would’ve given the heroes an advantage, one after another, nano.”
“Motoyasu-kun’s talked about that a fair bit too.”
“Thorough, aren’t they. And yet losing to that is quite the joke in itself. Hahaha.”
Itsuki’s eyes weren’t laughing at all, I say.
“Incidentally, it’s been confirmed that person was likely involved in disturbances all across the world, nano. Bow Hero, they might even be a distant cause of what happened to you, nano.”
“I see. If they’ve already been defeated, it doesn’t much matter to me. In the end, it’s not as if this world’s events were erased because of it, is it.”
“Well, that’s true, nano.”
And so, chatting away like that, we watched Ren dash through the dungeon, I say. Frankly, it was rather dull, indeed.
“Please call me when it’s my turn, pyon. I want to play tag with Yuki-chan and the others on the beach, pyon.”
A most delightful beach outing, I say.
“Well, just standing here watching is a waste of time too… seems like there are midpoints and you can move around freely… I’ll just come back when it’s my turn, I suppose?”
The map was fairly spacious, indeed. With Wolf standing by here, Father was free to move about. I, too, figured it wouldn’t be a problem to step away for a while.
“Maybe I should turn into a peckul too and pick up some skills while I’m at it? Can they be reacquired?”
“Should be possible, nano.”
“Peeen! Naofumi-sama, once I’ve learned various things, I’ll swim and guide you all around this area, vohppen!”
“Your verbal tics are getting quite busy…”
“…Hmph, I suppose I’ll go polish my swimming as well.”
Crocodile Guy seemed set on heading out to swim.
“Go get ’em, Ren-sama!”
Ren’s companions were cheering him on too, indeed.
“Earning levels there is important, but there’s also equipment that only drops on specific islands, so make sure to collect that too, nano.”
“I know, I know.”
“Itsuki, the Riska mascot costume that’s Riska’s outfit can also be obtained on this island, I say.”
“Bueh!?”
“Isn’t that supposed to be Rishia-san’s outfit, I’d think?”
“Well, nano, it might be good to have on hand for conversing with Spear Hero too, nano. The stats aren’t bad either, nano.”

“Yeah, yeah. I’ll go pick through the good ones later—oh, Naofumi-san. Please take Imiya-san along with you, would you? You haven’t really spent much time with her lately, have you? Try to get closer to her.”
“Kelsus agrees with that too, pyon.”

In my memory, the sprite that had become Mole—whose personality now resembled Big Sister’s—seemed to be lodging some sort of protest, I say. Please don’t drag her into that circle of slaves centered around Crocodile Guy and the rest! I’m not strong enough at this point in time to mix in there! …But surely that’s just my imagination. After all, even Big Sister has been seen calling out to Father cheerfully enough. Now that I think of it, since Mole tends to grow quickly, and given how difficult it currently is for Older Sister or Panda to form a bond with Father ahead of Rival, perhaps now’s the moment for her to grow in a way that brings Big Sister’s more aggressive side to the fore, and get close to Father that way. “Absolutely impossible in this situation!” the Big Sister in my memory seems to be saying as well, but since there’s at least a sliver of a chance, it’s a challenge worth taking, pyo~n!
